Moreover, there is evidence that integrating brief periods of detraining can restore the anabolic responsiveness of trained muscle (56). It is therefore possible that bodybuilders in the Alway and colleagues (5) study might have improved their hypertrophic response by periodizing volume and intensity over the course of the training cycle to include deload periods that facilitate remodeling and rejuvenation.
